sentences.en: Two years before the Darwin - Wallace paper, an obscure Austrian monk by the name of Gregor Mendel had started work on crossbreeding varieties of peas.

sentences.en: In summer 1854 the weather-beaten Mendel planted 34 strains of pea in the garden of the monastery where he worked and started to make a hereditary research of the crossbreeding of plants.
